image_urls.description: Authentic homemade Indian thali and tiffin spread
Grand catering buffet feast with silver chafing dishes
Freshly prepared aromatic Indian dal and curries

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete full-stack web application for Navyug Catering & Tiffin Services with FastAPI backend and React frontend.
Implement MongoDB database entities for User, Menu Item, Order, Order Item snapshots, Catering Inquiry, and Contact Inquiry.
Ensure burgundy/deep red (#800020) and warm Indian food aesthetics throughout with Playfair Display and Plus Jakarta Sans fonts.
Include secure JWT-based auth with registration, login, logout, profile, and order history.
Include protected first-admin setup screen and robust admin dashboard for menu CRUD, orders management, catering inquiries, and contact messages.
Ensure all interactive elements and key informational elements have data-testid attributes.
Support dynamic menu categories (Dal, Punjabi, Rice, Paneer) with availability toggle and pricing.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays.
Ensure high contrast and WCAG APCA compliance.
Add proper data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, inputs, and cards.
Never use generic AI assistant emojis.
